name: Ticket Work
description: Scopes the session to a single Jira ticket — pulls the ticket via Atlassian integration on first run, sets up per-ticket notes, and locks all work to that ticket's scope.

pullOnStart.label: Pull On Start
pullOnStart.description: When on, TPM auto-pulls the ticket from Jira at session start via Atlassian Suite. When off, the ticket description must be supplied manually. The ticket key is always derived from the branch name either way.

crossTicketStrictness.label: Cross Ticket Strictness
crossTicketStrictness.description: How TPM responds to references to work outside the active ticket. ask (default): confirm before treating it as in-scope. hard-block: refuse until this mode is disabled. soft-warn: warn once and proceed.

notesSections.label: Notes Sections
notesSections.description: Comma-separated top-level sections for the per-ticket notes file, in write order. Session Handoff's content is written by tool.session-handoff; section structure and templates come from tool.obsidian-notes — this list only selects and orders sections.
notesSections.default: Ticket Summary, Implementation Notes, Changes Made, Edge Cases, Testing Procedures, QA Findings, Session Handoff
